title: Frontend: Voting Eligibility
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Voting Eligibility. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution({age,minimum}). Return age >= minimum for nonnegative integer age and minimum. Reject invalid values with Invalid age. This is a configurable threshold model, not a jurisdiction-specific legal rule.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Accept a validated integer age and a caller-supplied minimum age, then compare them directly.
alternativeApproaches: Accept a birth date and calculate completed calendar years before applying the supplied threshold.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Below, at, above threshold; negative; fraction.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
